surface.basis: Pirelli 2025 British GP preview: asphalt grip 4/5, asphalt abrasion 2/5. Other ratings, not used here: traction 3, braking 2, lateral 5, tyre stress 5, track evolution 2, downforce 4.

source.notes: TUM smoothed OpenStreetMap centreline with surveyed widths, scaled to the FIA 5,891 m. Heights: SRTM 30 m (public domain) through Open Topo Data, sampled every 20 m along gb-1948 from bacinger/f1-circuits, lined up by curvature and smoothed over about 200 m.
